policy: Track upstream master explicitly; never label a pinned upstream commit as a personal fork. Once the fork is created, set upstream as upstream remote and the personal fork as origin; keep LEONES submodule pinned to a reviewed fork commit.
notes: The upstream commit was fetched from GitHub API during this verification.
The current GitHub connector can read repositories and write files/branches/PRs but does not expose repository-fork creation.
No source files from llama.cpp have been copied into LEONES.
